name: Keyboard cleaner
author: ReidenXerx
description: Switch every key off while you wipe your keyboard and touchpad. A themed full-screen card counts down; hold a click on the ring to unlock early, or let the timer end it.

barWidget.description: Click to lock the keyboard and touchpad for cleaning

schema.label: Lock for (seconds)
schema.description: How long cleaning mode lasts before it unlocks by itself. Holding a click on the ring for three seconds unlocks it earlier.
